records.subject: Still want to get River Collective set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Good to see River Collective isn't working solo anymore. How's the first week felt with another person in there?

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *River Collective* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Positive signals: first_project reached day 3 and 1 invite sent, with 8 days left in window. But key_milestone still unreached at day 6 and Ana never replied to either outreach ([email:04e7e405], [email:f5f22b70]), suggesting low momentum; no tickets either way.

draft.subject: One next step for River Collective
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

You've got River Collective's first project up and a teammate invited — nice start. The usual next step is getting real work living inside that project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week to look at how you'd like River Collective's work mapped into projects, or to answer anything over email.

Best,
Priya
